threats.title: Media Database Breach
threats.description:
Attackers gain unauthorized access to the Media Database containing:
- All video surveillance footage from cameras
- Extracted facial biometrics and feature vectors
- Temporal metadata (when and where faces were detected)
- Associations between faces and pseudonym IDs

STRIDE Category: Information Disclosure

threats.title: Facial Recognition Model Tampering
threats.description:
An attacker gains unauthorized access to the facial recognition model and modifies its weights, training data, or inference logic. 
STRIDE Category: Tampering

threats.title: Facial Recognition Misidentification
threats.description:
The facial recognition system fails to correctly identify individuals. This could be done by spoofing attacks with crafted images/masks. Flagging innocent visitors as intruders could lead to information disclosure.
STRIDE Category: Spoofing / Information Disclosure

threats.title: Over-Privileged Identity Resolver Access
threats.description:
The Identity Resolver process has excessive permissions to query all identity mappings and real identity data.
STRIDE Category: Elevation of Privilege / Information Disclosure

threats.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) in Media Linker
threats.description:
The Media Linker does not properly validate access control when linking extracted facial biometric data to visitor identities. An attacker could link biometric data to a different authorized person record.
STRIDE Category: Information Disclosure / Elevation of Privilege
